## WF05 – Missing information handler
Asks ONLY for the missing mandatory fields, in one short message (deterministic template).

* Debounced: WhatsApp bursts ("3 pax", "17 Nov"...) are merged before asking (`CLARIFICATION_DEBOUNCE_SECONDS_*`).
* Never asks the same question twice; escalates to a human after `MAX_CLARIFICATIONS`.
* Triggered by WF06 (immediate check) and every minute.
